section3: Rackstor UK Ltd provides a fully managed, step-by-step racking relocation service in Forres. We commence with a pre-dismantling structural survey and photographic audit to record existing equipment health and layout configurations. Our certified installation engineers then perform a systematic component-level dismantling procedure, labelling all frames, beams, bracing, and locking hardware. Racking is transported safely using our internal fleet of dedicated vehicles. At the new site, we reassemble the system to original or adapted SEMA-compliant specifications, fix upright baseplates into the concrete slab using certified anchors, install official SEMA load notices, execute a rigorous safety audit, and provide a comprehensive written completion report.
